diagnosis: The page completed and scored the formal run, but placed the result only in localStorage and a page-global property. Browser-review tooling intentionally does not expose either surface, so the required per-sample JSON could not be exported without violating the browser safety contract.

perSampleResultRecovery.reason: The export surface was inaccessible and no missing per-sample values were reconstructed.

fix: The completed object is now also emitted as inert application/json text in `.visual-read-result`, guarded by `data-result-ready=1` on the review root.
